thread:
ana: quick idea 12 Seed Sprint: 3 micro-tutorials + a tiny refapp + a 40-45m demo webinar. primary goals: community contribution, reusable launch assets, and a short benchmark story we can publish. :seedling:

sam: sounds good. propose one mono-repo with lesson folders (quickstart, perf, infra) and a small Next.js refapp that calls the hosted API. starter issues for new contributors.

jordan: benchmarks: keep them minimal and reproducible. include a bench script and a config YAML. metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and estimated cost per 1k tokens.

li: visuals: one hero image, two 10-15s GIFs (demo + perf chart), and standard social sizes. i'll make templates so ops can schedule quickly.

marta: i can reach out to two community maintainers to join the webinar panel and help promote the repo.

ana: landing page should capture email + hidden param `cohort=seed-sprint` so we route leads. sam, can you standardize utm params?

sam: use `?utm_source=seed_sprint&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=seed_launch`. ops will add the redirect and hidden tracking.

devrel-bot: Reminder: create checklist in #marketing-launches and assign due dates.

jordan: content cadence idea: Day 0 scaffold + tutorial 1; Day 1 community sprint; Day 2 finalize tutorials + run benchmarks; Day 3 webinar & launch post. compact but keeps momentum.

ana: messaging: developer-first headline + a short paragraph for product/enterprise followups. keep the launch post example-driven and include a small FAQ for keys, VPC, and model licensing.

li: outreach: X, LinkedIn, community newsletters, and OSS forums. prioritize snack reels for social.

marta: action items for today: sam -> repo scaffold + starter issues, li -> hero + GIFs, ana -> landing page draft, jordan -> bench script template. EOD deliverables?

ana: yep. i'll collate into a one-page brief and drop it in #marketing-launches. excited to test this micro-cohort flow. :rocket:
